name: B10-0131/2024 (ESN) – Situation in Azerbaijan, violation of human rights and international law and relations with Armenia
title: Situation in Azerbaijan, violation of human rights and international law and relations with Armenia
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion on the situation between Armenia and Azerbaijan. It notes that Azerbaijan refused to sign a peace treaty in September 2024 and urges both sides to keep talking and settle their disputes through the peace treaty. It condemns the destruction and damage of Armenian cultural and religious sites in Nagorno-Karabakh and asks Azerbaijan to let foreign observers check and protect those sites.

- No law changes; Parliament only states its opinion and calls for continued peace talks.
- Azerbaijan is asked to let foreign observers monitor cultural sites in Nagorno-Karabakh.
- The resolution is sent to the Commission, Council and both countries' governments; no further action is set out.
